name: guest-morph-motion
title: Guest Morph (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A pill of overlapping faces that morphs into a guest list when pressed. Replies are grouped as Going, Maybe and Pending, and the card has an invite form that adds a pending invite. Use it for an event, a shared plan or any list of people who have answered.
docs: Motion build of `guest-morph` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named export: GuestMorph (plus the Guest type). `title` is the event's name; `guests` is the starting list of { id, name, status: going | maybe | pending, note?, since? }. The Invite button opens an email field: `onInvite(email)` runs first, and a returned promise that rejects shows its message instead of adding the invite; a valid, new address is added as Pending and can be cancelled. `onChange` receives the list after every invite or cancel. GSAP build with a Motion twin (guest-morph-motion, shared layoutId morph); Escape, the close button or a press outside folds the card back, and focus moves with it. Honours prefers-reduced-motion.
